blocks.label: Overview
bullets: With Elderberry, Vitamin C, and Zinc
paragraphs: The berries and flowers of elderberry are packed with antioxidants and vitamins that may boost your immune system. Zinc is found in cells throughout the body. It helps your immune system fight off invading bacteria and viruses.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: As a dietary supplement, take two (2) chewable tablets per day. Chew thoroughly before swallowing.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Sugar, natural flavors, stearic acid, magnesium stearate, silica, and rebaudioside A.
Does not contain eggs, wheat (gluten), milk, peanuts, tree nuts, sesame, soy, fish or shellfish.
Made in the USA with global and domestic ingredients.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Do not exceed suggested use. If you have a medical condition, are taking medication, or are pregnant or nursing, ask a doctor before using. Not for children under 2 years of age due to risk of choking.
Do not use this product if safety seal under cap is torn or missing.
Keep out of reach of children.
Store at room temperature. Avoid excessive heat.
